Class ConfigValueFormatter

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.utils.ConfigValueFormatter
public final class ConfigValueFormatter extends Object
Converts raw protobuf values to user-friendly text and back. This covers IPv4 addresses stored in protobuf as little-endian fixed32 values and bitmask fields that are easier to edit as a set of flags than as a raw number.
